findings.summary: The fragment cites -0.021339473744693815 (line 201) and +0.061765 (line 267) as the same Newton matrix 'read at the operator's bound-breaking direction' and 'at that operator's TOP direction, but no receipt carries either number and no committed code path in scripts/iron_operator_bound/persisted.py computes the matrix at a caller-supplied direction; witness-graded-16-80.json and witness-uniform-0.08.json carry the +0.061765 figure nowhere. The claim these support (the operator's own direction is already indefinite) is corroborated by newton_minimum and the closed form, so the headline stands, but the two numbers are unverifiable citations.

The suite table reports the head arm at f2afbe069d5bb0a2db8b93ef8e3fa5551622111c as 'cut short at 5 of 101 tests' and line 361 says 'the head arm is recorded as incomplete rather than as a pass', while gate-head-fast.log (written after the last commit) records a completed head arm at 4aa6ca3adb7d043466e21d6bb7371e9963ad7864 with 100 passed, 5 failed, 14 deselected. The fragment was never updated to the completed arm, so a later reader consulting it would believe the head arm never completed.

check_labels re-implements the clipped-and-overlapping-text figure audit that scripts/edge_sheet/figure.py already implements, adding another script-local copy rather than the style-module owner the plotting rules name; a later figure's saved audit can drift from this one.

generalised_spectrum builds the metric-weighted generalised block eigenproblem (cholesky reduction plus signed singular values) independently of nova/biot/magnetisation.py:370 galerkin_block_spectrum, which owns the same symmetrisation and 1/mu0 normalisation for the assembled interaction; the docstring states why the owner's global signature cannot return a per-cell band, so this is a documented sibling rather than an accidental fork, but the reduction machinery is duplicated.

The three bound receipts predates the eigen_tolerance field added at :907 and carry no tolerance, so the reading's stopping criterion is not recorded beside the eigen-residual; the residual is recorded so the reading is self-described, but the manifest's claim that only the uniform-0.04 receipt predates the field is inaccurate to the other two.
